name: Parabohaiornis
sum: Bohaiornithid from the Jiufotang Formation of Liaoning known from two specimens.
holotype: IVPP V 18691, a nearly complete, partly articulated skeleton and skull.
material: The holotype and IVPP V 18690, an articulated skeleton lacking the skull, ulna, radius and hands.
biology: Not given in the sources used.
author: Wang et al. 2014

sources.text: Min Wang 2014. A new diverse enantiornithine family (Bohaiornithidae fam. nov.) from the Lower Cretaceous of China with information from two new species. Vertebrata PalAsiatica 52(1): 31–76.
